title: Paper only: is Welford's variance really more stable?
description: A short paper excerpt claims Welford's online algorithm stays accurate when data sit far from zero, while the textbook one-pass formula breaks down. No code: Nemotron implements both from the text.
question: Is Welford's online variance algorithm actually more accurate than the one-pass sum-of-squares formula, and does its advantage grow as the data's mean moves away from zero relative to its spread?
